title: [BUG]   ' Approaching 5-hour limit'
body: ## Environment Terminal (wsl)-> Claude Codee -> version: 1.0.86 ## Bug Description The yellow text: ' Approaching 5-hour limit' remains even if I restart Claude Code. I tried both restarting it and closing the terminal and restarting it. Is the same. ## Steps to Reproduce I don't know, it is the first time ## Expected Behavior I expect that if I close Claude (by typing exit) and restart it, the text will disappear. ## Actual Behavior The text remains ## Additional Context
author: rufio72
